description:
Yu Jaeshin, a Crown Prince destined never to rule, reunites with Mo Yeo-hwa, a fallen blacksmith cursed to die when a flower-shaped mark on her chest wilts. Jaeshin takes her in to forge weapons for his war efforts, and they embark on a journey filled with peril and despair.
Yeo-hwa struggles with a burning pain she cannot endure alone, and Jaeshin becomes her only solace. As they confront their cursed fates—his entrapment by imperial schemes and her inevitable death—their journey shifts from one of despair toward hope, love, and a fight for life over death.
